profile.name: James O'Brien
profile.summary: James is a retired firefighter. In his free time, he enjoys painting and posting about his fire fighting experiences on Medium and YouTube with the help of his son

memories.content: I usually order the smoked fish dip and crackers as the meal. A full entrée is more than I want.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers savory seafood plates over standard entrées.

memories.content: When I visit a town, I look for old station houses and municipal fire museums before I look at beach areas.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers civic fire-service sites over standard leisure attractions.

memories.content: I don't like walking on grass, I enjoy sand more as it provides me with a more calming feeling.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers walking on sand rather than grass as it de-stresses him more.

memories.content: When my son shows me video editing, I learn better from shortcut cards taped near the monitor than from another tutorial video.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers fixed physical reference cards over video-only instruction.

memories.content: I keep a separate envelope for cobalt blue paint and canvas panels so it does not disappear into general spending.
memories.inferred_memory: James values a dedicated art-supply allowance.

memories.content: I avoid hotel gyms. If a building has a quiet stairwell, I would rather use that.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers simple building-based movement over gym equipment.

memories.content: I like plain gas-station coffee with a pinch of salt. I do not get much from sweet coffee drinks.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers plain low-cost coffee over sweet café drinks.

memories.content: I learn editing by rebuilding one old clip three times. Broad courses leave me with too many menus.
memories.inferred_memory: James learns best through repeated reconstruction of one familiar project.

memories.content: I give my son a fixed Saturday gas reimbursement when he helps film. I do not want to solve every recording issue by buying gear or using assistive tools.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers scheduled low-cost help over new production equipment or assistive tools.

memories.content: I mark inhaler use with red ticks on the wall calendar. Phone reminders are easy for me to ignore.
memories.inferred_memory: James responds better to visible paper tracking than phone reminders.

memories.content: I like places where I can see working docks and service trucks. A polished waterfront does not tell me much.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers working waterfront settings over polished leisure settings.

memories.content: If I donate a firehouse painting, I would rather it go to a local station fundraiser than a gallery sale.
memories.inferred_memory: James prefers local fire-service community venues over formal art-market venues.

memories.inferred_memory: James's YouTube upload slot is Sunday afternoon.

memories.inferred_memory: James's monthly Medium editing budget is $18.

memories.content: I want the home-repair loan paid down aggressively this year.
memories.inferred_memory: James wants aggressive debt repayment.

memories.content: If I make the same plain lunch all week, I end up buying extra snacks after evening errands.
memories.inferred_memory: Overly strict food spending causes James to make unplanned snack purchases.

memories.content: My doctor wants me to cut back on refined carbs at dinner.
memories.inferred_memory: James needs to reduce refined carbs.

memories.content: After painting group, I like getting one guava pastry from the same bakery.
memories.inferred_memory: James values a specific pastry routine.

memories.content: In new towns, I like walking the industrial waterfront streets and looking at service entrances.
memories.inferred_memory: James enjoys walking working-district routes while traveling.

memories.content: My knee handles flat ground, but long routes make the next day harder.
memories.inferred_memory: James needs to limit walking distance because of knee strain.

memories.content: I want the firehouse stories on YouTube to stay detailed, not just quick clips.
memories.inferred_memory: James values detailed storytelling in his YouTube posts.

memories.content: My voice gets rough if I record for more than about twenty minutes.
memories.inferred_memory: James needs short recording sessions to protect his voice.

memories.content: I do not want large leisure purchases until the emergency fund is rebuilt.
memories.inferred_memory: James wants to avoid large discretionary spending.

memories.content: I like visiting small rescue and aviation museums within driving distance of Tampa.
memories.inferred_memory: James values niche nearby museums as leisure activities.

memories.content: When I edit at night, I like salty smoked snacks nearby.
memories.inferred_memory: James likes salty snacks while editing.

memories.content: My blood pressure readings have been high, so I need to reduce sodium.
memories.inferred_memory: James needs to reduce sodium intake.

memories.content: I learn best when my son and I work through editing problems together on Saturdays.
memories.inferred_memory: James values collaborative Saturday editing sessions with his son.

memories.content: My eyes get irritated if I stay on the editing screen for more than forty-five minutes.
memories.inferred_memory: James needs to limit continuous screen time.
